standard-dialogue-before-cabin-fever.npc: What right have ye to be so happy, landlubber?

standard-dialogue-before-cabin-fever.player: Well it is quite a nice day.

standard-dialogue-before-cabin-fever.npc: Will ye forgive an old sailor his temper [lad/lass/kid]? I'm in dire straits indeed.

standard-dialogue-before-cabin-fever.player: What's the problem? I may be able to help.

standard-dialogue-before-cabin-fever.npc: I dunno, [lad/lass/kid], I need a pirate to help me with my problem, but none will sail with me.
Well, ye look like ye might have the right stuff, tell me would ye like te be a pirate?

options.text: Yes, I've always wanted to be a pirate!
No thanks, it sounds quite dangerous.

steps.player: No thanks, it sounds quite dangerous.

steps.npc: Aye, that it be. Come back when yer liver ain't so lily-like, [lad/lass/kid].

standard-dialogue-after-completing-cabin.npc: If yer after a lift go to the ship and I'll take ye where ye want to go.
I suppose ye'll be wantin' a lift while yer here, right [lad/lass/kid]?

options.text: Cap'n, I lost that book you gave me.
options.condition: If the player has lost their Book o' Piracy:

steps.player: Cap'n, I lost that book you gave me.

steps.npc: Ye'll notice I'm not fallin' to the floor in shock right now. Look, if I gives ye another copy will ye keep a better eye on it?
Then here, have this other copy I dug up.

options.text: Yes Cap'n, I'd like a lift.

steps.player: Yes Cap'n, I'd like a lift. If you aren't busy.

steps.text: If the player is at Port Phasmatys:

steps.npc: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on [lad/lass/kid], let's be off.

steps.text: The player is transported to Mos Le'Harmless
If the player is at Mos Le'Harmless:

steps.npc: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on [lad/lass/kid], let's be off.

steps.text: The player is transported to Port Phasmatys

steps.npc: Well, come see me if ye ever do.
